I am writing to raise a formal complaint about the unacceptable level of service my family has recently experienced at your surgery.

Firstly, we faced an extremely long waiting period when trying to secure an appointment for our newborn. As new parents, timely medical care is essential, and the delays we encountered were both stressful and concerning. The lack of availability and excessive waiting times are simply not acceptable, especially for an infant who may require prompt attention.

Secondly, my partner attended the surgery for a scheduled smear test and was left waiting for over an hour, only to be told afterwards that she could not have the test yet. This situation shows a serious breakdown in communication and organisation. If the appointment was not appropriate or could not go ahead, this should have been identified before the appointment—or at the very least communicated at the start, rather than after an hour of waiting.

Both of these experiences have caused us significant frustration and have undermined our confidence in the surgery’s ability to provide safe, efficient, and well-coordinated care.

I ask that you investigate these issues and provide an explanation for the delays, as well as what actions will be taken to prevent similar situations in the future. Patients deserve clear communication, respect for their time, and reliable access to healthcare. At present, that standard is not being met.

I look forward to your prompt response.

Kind regards,
